#[path = "support/selection.rs"]
mod selection;
use crossterm::event::{KeyCode, KeyEvent, KeyModifiers};
use polaris::{
    app::{App, Entry, EntryKind},
    interaction::{TextRegionId, UiMap, ViewSelection},
    runtime::selection_text,
    theme::{Theme, ThemeMode},
    ui,
};
use ratatui::{
    Terminal,
    backend::TestBackend,
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier},
    widgets::{Paragraph, Wrap},
};
fn capture(app: &App, w: u16, h: u16) -> (Buffer, UiMap) {
    let mut t = Terminal::new(TestBackend::new(w, h)).unwrap();
    let mut map = UiMap::default();
    t.draw(|f| map = ui::render_interactive(f, app)).unwrap();
    (t.backend().buffer().clone(), map)
}
fn text(b: &Buffer, r: Rect) -> String {
    (r.y..r.bottom())
        .map(|y| {
            (r.x..r.right())
                .map(|x| b[(x, y)].symbol())
                .collect::<String>()
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n")
}
fn esc(app: &mut App) {
    app.key(KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Esc, KeyModifiers::NONE));
}
fn is_artwork_color(c: Color) -> bool {
    matches!(
        c,
        Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70)
            | Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172)
            | Color::Rgb(184, 184, 184)
            | Color::Rgb(107, 107, 107)
            | Color::Rgb(28, 28, 28)
    )
}
fn logo_rect(compact: bool) -> Rect {
    Rect::new(
        2,
        2,
        if compact { 11 } else { 15 },
        if compact { 5 } else { 7 },
    )
}
#[test]
fn balanced_welcome_aligns_metadata_and_leaves_composer_and_footer_fixed() {
    let app = App::default();
    for (w, h) in [
        (120, 40),
        (120, 36),
        (120, 35),
        (100, 30),
        (90, 30),
        (89, 40),
        (80, 24),
        (60, 20),
    ] {
        let (b, map) = capture(&app, w, h);
        assert_eq!(text(&b, Rect::new(0, 0, w, 2)).trim(), "");
        let (tx, ty) = (20, 3);
        assert_eq!(text(&b, Rect::new(tx, ty, 7, 1)), "Polaris");
        assert!(b[(tx, ty)].modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD));
        assert_eq!(b[(tx + 8, ty)].fg, Color::Rgb(133, 133, 133));
        assert!(!b[(tx + 8, ty)].modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD));
        assert_eq!(
            text(&b, Rect::new(tx, ty + 1, 22, 1)),
            "Account not configured"
        );
        let logo = logo_rect(false);
        let mut ink = Vec::new();
        for y in 0..h {
            for x in 0..w {
                let c = &b[(x, y)];
                if is_artwork_color(c.fg) || is_artwork_color(c.bg) {
                    ink.push((x, y));
                }
            }
        }
        assert!(!ink.is_empty());
        assert!(ink.iter().all(|&(x, y)| logo.contains((x, y).into())));
        assert_eq!(ink.iter().map(|p| p.0).min(), Some(2));
        assert_eq!(ink.iter().map(|p| p.0).max(), Some(16));
        assert_eq!(ink.iter().map(|p| p.1).min(), Some(2));
        assert_eq!(ink.iter().map(|p| p.1).max(), Some(8));
        assert!(text(&b, Rect::new(17, 2, 3, 7)).trim().is_empty());
        assert_eq!(map.region(&TextRegionId::Composer).unwrap().rect.y, h - 3);
        assert_eq!(text(&b, Rect::new(0, h - 2, w, 1)).trim(), "");
        assert!(text(&b, Rect::new(0, h - 1, w, 1)).contains("auto mode on"));
    }
}
#[test]
fn typing_submission_popups_previews_and_clear_restore_the_right_artwork() {
    let mut app = App::default();
    let (welcome, _) = capture(&app, 120, 40);
    app.input.set("Typing retains the welcome star");
    assert_eq!(
        text(&welcome, logo_rect(false)),
        text(&capture(&app, 120, 40).0, logo_rect(false))
    );
    app.submit();
    app.working = false;
    let (chat, map) = capture(&app, 120, 40);
    assert_ne!(
        text(&welcome, logo_rect(false)),
        text(&chat, logo_rect(false))
    );
    assert!(text(&chat, logo_rect(true)).contains("─✦─"));
    assert_eq!(map.region(&TextRegionId::Conversation).unwrap().rect.y, 8);
    for command in [
        "/model",
        "/status",
        "/stats",
        "/providers",
        "/preview",
        "/onboarding",
    ] {
        app.command(command);
        let (popup, map) = capture(&app, 120, 40);
        assert_eq!(
            text(&popup, logo_rect(true)),
            text(&chat, logo_rect(true)),
            "{command}"
        );
        let sheet = ui::popup_area(&app, Rect::new(0, 0, 120, 40));
        assert!(sheet.y > 2);
        assert!(map.text_regions.iter().all(|r| {
            r.cells
                .iter()
                .all(|c| c.y < sheet.y || c.y >= sheet.bottom())
        }));
        esc(&mut app);
        assert_eq!(
            text(&capture(&app, 120, 40).0, logo_rect(true)),
            text(&chat, logo_rect(true))
        );
    }
    app.paste(&"long paste\n".repeat(60));
    let id = app.input.spans[0].attachment.id;
    app.open_attachment(id);
    assert_eq!(
        text(&capture(&app, 120, 40).0, logo_rect(true)),
        text(&chat, logo_rect(true))
    );
    esc(&mut app);
    app.command("/clear");
    assert_eq!(
        text(&capture(&app, 120, 40).0, logo_rect(false)),
        text(&welcome, logo_rect(false))
    );
}
#[test]
fn long_unicode_metadata_ellipsizes_without_overwriting_artwork_or_right_margin() {
    let mut app = App::default();
    app.account_email = Some("开发者👩‍💻é-account".repeat(20));
    app.workspace = "C:/项目/🦀/workspace/".repeat(20);
    for ascii in [false, true] {
        app.ascii = ascii;
        let (b, _) = capture(&app, 60, 20);
        for y in [4, 6] {
            assert!(text(&b, Rect::new(20, y, 38, 1)).ends_with(if ascii { "..." } else { "…" }));
            assert_eq!(text(&b, Rect::new(58, y, 2, 1)), "  ");
        }
        assert!(text(&b, Rect::new(17, 2, 3, 7)).trim().is_empty());
        assert_eq!(text(&b, Rect::new(20, 3, 7, 1)), "Polaris");
        assert!(text(&b, Rect::new(20, 7, 38, 1)).trim().is_empty());
    }
}
#[test]
fn resize_scroll_limits_selection_and_source_cells_share_the_header_geometry() {
    let mut app = App::default();
    let lines: Vec<_> = (0..100)
        .map(|n| format!("line {n:03} contains actual selectable text"))
        .collect();
    app.entries.push(Entry {
        draft: None,
        kind: EntryKind::User,
        title: String::new(),
        lines: lines.clone(),
    });
    for (w, h) in [(120, 40), (60, 20), (100, 30), (80, 24), (120, 40)] {
        for scroll in [usize::MAX, 0] {
            app.scroll = scroll;
            let (before, map) = capture(&app, w, h);
            let r = map.region(&TextRegionId::Conversation).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(r.rect.y, 8);
            assert_eq!(r.rect.bottom(), h - ui::composer_height(&app, w) - 2);
            let rendered = ui::entry_lines(&app.entries[0], &app, false);
            let total = Paragraph::new(rendered)
                .wrap(Wrap { trim: false })
                .line_count(w - 4);
            assert_eq!(
                ui::conversation_max_scroll(&app, w, h),
                total - r.rect.height as usize
            );
            for c in &r.cells {
                let source = &r.source[c.byte_offset..];
                if let Some(ch) = source.chars().next().filter(|ch| !ch.is_whitespace()) {
                    assert_eq!(
                        before[(c.x, c.y)].symbol(),
                        ch.to_string(),
                        "mapped wrong glyph at {w}x{h}, scroll {scroll}"
                    );
                }
            }
            if scroll == usize::MAX {
                assert!(r.cells.iter().any(|c| c.byte_offset == 0));
            } else {
                assert!(text(&before, r.rect).contains("line 099"));
            }
            app.view_selection = Some(ViewSelection {
                region: TextRegionId::Conversation,
                anchor: 0,
                end: r.source.len(),
            });
            let (selected, selected_map) = capture(&app, w, h);
            assert_eq!(
                selection_text(&app, &selected_map),
                lines.join(
                    "
"
                )
            );
            for (index, (a, b)) in before.content.iter().zip(&selected.content).enumerate() {
                let (x, y) = ((index % w as usize) as u16, (index / w as usize) as u16);
                let copied = r.cells.iter().any(|c| {
                    c.x == x
                        && c.y == y
                        && c.byte_offset < r.source.len()
                        && !r.source[c.byte_offset..].starts_with('\n')
                });
                assert_eq!(
                    b.bg,
                    if copied {
                        selection::background(app.theme, a)
                    } else {
                        a.bg
                    }
                );
            }
            app.view_selection = None;
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn ansi_ascii_and_no_color_fallbacks_keep_the_hybrid_and_small_terminal_guard() {
    for rgb in [true, false] {
        for color in [true, false] {
            for ascii in [true, false] {
                for mode in [ThemeMode::Dark, ThemeMode::Terminal] {
                    let mut app = App::default();
                    app.theme = Theme { mode, color, rgb };
                    app.ascii = ascii;
                    for chat in [false, true] {
                        if chat {
                            app.entries
                                .push(Entry::new(EntryKind::User, "", &["hello"]));
                        }
                        let (b, _) = capture(&app, 100, 30);
                        let art = text(&b, logo_rect(chat));
                        assert!(!art.contains("NV"));
                        assert!(!art.chars().any(|c| "█▀▄║═╔╗╚╝╧╤╢╟".contains(c)));
                        if ascii {
                            assert!(text(&b, b.area).is_ascii());
                            assert!(art.contains('*'));
                        } else {
                            assert!(art.contains('✦'));
                            assert!(art.contains('┤'));
                        }
                        if !color {
                            assert!(
                                b.content
                                    .iter()
                                    .all(|c| c.fg == Color::Reset && c.bg == Color::Reset)
                            );
                        }
                        if mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
                            assert!(b.content.iter().all(|c| c.bg == Color::Reset));
                        }
                        if !rgb {
                            assert!(b.content.iter().all(|c| !matches!(c.fg, Color::Rgb(..))
                                && !matches!(c.bg, Color::Rgb(..))));
                        }
                        if ascii && chat {
                            assert_eq!(
                                art,
                                "   | | |   \n +-+-+-+-+ \n-+  -*-  +-\n +-+-+-+-+ \n   | | |   "
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let small = ui::dump(&App::default(), 59, 19).unwrap();
    assert!(small.contains("Resize to at least"));
    assert!(!small.contains("v0.1.0alpha"));
}
#[test]
fn hybrid_uses_fine_gray_frame_green_star_lime_traces_and_one_mint_highlight() {
    for compact in [false, true] {
        let mut app = App::default();
        if compact {
            app.entries
                .push(Entry::new(EntryKind::User, "", &["hello"]));
        }
        let (b, _) = capture(&app, 80, 24);
        let r = logo_rect(compact);
        let expected = if compact {
            "   │ │ │   \n ┌─┴─┴─┴─┐ \n─┤  ─✦─  ├─\n └─┬─┬─┬─┘ \n   │ │ │   "
        } else {
            "    │  │  │    \n  ┌─┴──┴──┴─┐  \n  │    ╷    │  \n──┤  ╶─✦─╴  ├──\n  │    ╵    │  \n  └─┬──┬──┬─┘  \n    │  │  │    "
        };
        assert_eq!(text(&b, r), expected);
        let (cx, cy) = if compact { (7, 4) } else { (9, 5) };
        assert_eq!(b[(cx, cy)].fg, Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70));
        for dx in [-1, 1] {
            assert_eq!(b[((cx as i16 + dx) as u16, cy)].fg, Color::Rgb(118, 185, 0));
        }
        let mint = if compact { (7, 2) } else { (9, 4) };
        assert_eq!(b[mint].fg, Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172));
        let (left, right, bottom) = if compact { (3, 11, 5) } else { (4, 14, 7) };
        let mut greens = 0;
        let mut mints = 0;
        for y in r.y..r.bottom() {
            for x in r.x..r.right() {
                let c = &b[(x, y)];
                assert!(!c.modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD));
                assert_eq!(
                    c.bg,
                    if (left..=right).contains(&x) && (3..=bottom).contains(&y) {
                        Color::Rgb(28, 28, 28)
                    } else {
                        Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0)
                    }
                );
                greens += usize::from(c.fg == Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70));
                mints += usize::from(c.fg == Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172));
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(greens, 1);
        assert_eq!(mints, 1);
        assert_eq!(b[(left, 3)].fg, Color::Rgb(184, 184, 184));
        assert_eq!(b[(right, bottom)].fg, Color::Rgb(107, 107, 107));
        assert_eq!(app.theme.accent().fg, Some(Color::Rgb(118, 185, 0)));
        assert_eq!(app.theme.auto_mode().fg, Some(Color::Rgb(245, 194, 231)));
        assert_eq!(app.theme.error().fg, Some(Color::Rgb(172, 66, 66)));
    }
}
#[test]
fn tall_unsent_drafts_compact_the_header_without_overlapping_the_composer() {
    let welcome = capture(&App::default(), 120, 40).0;
    let mut compact_app = App::default();
    compact_app
        .entries
        .push(Entry::new(EntryKind::Note, "Context", &["reference"]));
    let compact = capture(&compact_app, 120, 40).0;
    let mut app = App::default();
    for lines in [1, 4, 8, 12, 200] {
        let draft = (0..lines)
            .map(|n| format!("draft line {n:03}"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        app.input.set(&draft);
        for notice in ["", "Local layout test notice"] {
            app.notice = notice.into();
            for (w, h) in [(60, 20), (120, 40), (80, 24), (100, 30), (60, 20)] {
                let (b, map) = capture(&app, w, h);
                let body = h - ui::composer_height(&app, w).min(h - 10) - 2;
                let compact_now = body < 11;
                let rect = logo_rect(compact_now);
                assert_eq!(
                    text(&b, rect),
                    text(if compact_now { &compact } else { &welcome }, rect)
                );
                assert!(rect.bottom() < body);
                assert!(
                    text(&b, Rect::new(rect.right(), 2, 3, rect.height))
                        .trim()
                        .is_empty()
                );
                assert!(map.region(&TextRegionId::Composer).unwrap().rect.y >= body);
                assert!(text(&b, Rect::new(0, h - 2, w, 1)).trim().is_empty());
                assert_eq!(app.input.text, draft);
                assert!(app.entries.is_empty());
            }
        }
    }
    app.notice.clear();
    app.input.set("short again");
    assert_eq!(
        text(&capture(&app, 60, 20).0, logo_rect(false)),
        text(&welcome, logo_rect(false))
    );
}
#[test]
fn hybrid_surfaces_stay_confined_while_copy_selection_shades_text_across_themes() {
    for variant in 0..3 {
        for mode in [ThemeMode::Dark, ThemeMode::Terminal] {
            for color in [true, false] {
                for rgb in [true, false] {
                    for ascii in [true, false] {
                        let mut app = App::default();
                        app.theme = Theme { mode, color, rgb };
                        app.ascii = ascii;
                        app.input.set("Draft for selection coverage");
                        if variant == 1 {
                            app.entries.push(Entry::new(
                                EntryKind::Note,
                                "Context",
                                &["Selection preserves hybrid colors."],
                            ));
                        }
                        if variant == 2 {
                            app.command("/model");
                        }
                        let (before, map) = capture(&app, 80, 24);
                        app.input.anchor = Some(0);
                        if variant == 1 {
                            let source = &map.region(&TextRegionId::Conversation).unwrap().source;
                            app.view_selection = Some(ViewSelection {
                                region: TextRegionId::Conversation,
                                anchor: 0,
                                end: source.len(),
                            });
                        }
                        if variant == 2 {
                            app.selected = (app.selected + 1) % app.model_rows().len();
                        }
                        let (after, after_map) = capture(&app, 80, 24);
                        let rect = logo_rect(variant == 1);
                        for y in 0..24 {
                            for x in 0..80 {
                                let selected = after_map.text_regions.iter().any(|r| {
                                    (r.id == TextRegionId::Composer
                                        || (variant == 1 && r.id == TextRegionId::Conversation))
                                        && r.cells.iter().any(|c| {
                                            c.x == x
                                                && c.y == y
                                                && c.byte_offset < r.source.len()
                                                && !r.source[c.byte_offset..].starts_with('\n')
                                        })
                                });
                                let expected = if color && selected {
                                    selection::background(app.theme, &before[(x, y)])
                                } else {
                                    before[(x, y)].bg
                                };
                                assert_eq!(
                                    after[(x, y)].bg,
                                    expected,
                                    "selection surface at {x},{y}"
                                );
                                assert!(!after[(x, y)].modifier.contains(Modifier::REVERSED));
                                if is_artwork_color(before[(x, y)].bg) {
                                    assert!(rect.contains((x, y).into()));
                                }
                                if rect.contains((x, y).into()) {
                                    assert_eq!(before[(x, y)], after[(x, y)]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
